freeze_rule: After this file and its evaluator are committed, no threshold, candidate program, order seed, cost term, cache rule, or abstain rule may change in response to method-heldout or sealed-domain outcomes. A change requires a new protocol ID and all old failures remain reported.
claim_scope: Quality-constrained online physical planning without future-query knowledge; calibrated-safe, not formally safe.

quality_contract.certification_rule: For each calibration domain, average each query's loss over the natural order and 20 frozen permutations, then require: one-sided query-bootstrap upper mean regret <= 0.002; p95 of order-level mean regret <= 0.002; empirical Pr(order-averaged query regret > 0.05) <= 0.05; Wilson 95% upper bound <= 0.10. Every calibration domain must pass.

online_contract.logical_cost_function: C(P | R) = sum_{page in P minus R} 1; all pages have unit cost before the physical GPU gate.
online_contract.guard_rule: Execute Top-50 when its incremental cold-page cost is <= 40; otherwise execute the compiled floor when its cost is <= 40; otherwise ABSTAIN to Top-50 and charge its full cost.
online_contract.tie_breaking: Stable corpus position for score ties; deeper fidelity wins among budget-feasible nested plans.
online_contract.cache_eviction: Primary ablations use LRU with page-granular capacity round(0.20 * corpus pages).
online_contract.abstain_rule: ABSTAIN/FIXED_TOP50 if no non-reference program is empirically certified, or if no compiled non-reference plan is feasible under the online cold budget.

method_heldout_domain.name: irpapers
method_heldout_domain.role_warning: Did not participate in RBRC v0 design, but was opened in earlier ReprForge work; not a globally sealed paper test.

core_ablations.fixed_top50: No safety compiler, no residency planning, no abstain.
core_ablations.safety_only: Use the cheapest certified static floor; if none, abstain globally to Top-50. Primary cache remains LRU.
core_ablations.residency_only: Use the lowest candidate floor and the frozen residency guard without quality certification or abstain-on-uncertainty. Primary cache remains LRU.
core_ablations.complete_rbrc: Use the cheapest certified residency-guarded floor; if none, abstain globally to Top-50. Primary cache remains LRU.

blind_gate.quality: On every sealed domain, Complete RBRC's mean order-level signed regret must be <= 0.002 and its mean order-level query-violation rate must be <= 0.05 over the natural order and 50 frozen permutations.
blind_gate.cost: Complete RBRC must reduce mean logical cold reads by at least 10% versus fixed Top-50 under the same LRU policy and must not lose to both LFU and GDSF strong fixed baselines.
blind_gate.abstain: Report rather than hide abstention. More than 50% global/query abstention is a no-go for the headline method even if quality passes.
blind_gate.order_robustness: At least 90% of frozen query orders must reduce cold reads versus fixed Top-50+LRU.
blind_gate.decision: GPU physical-cost measurement is permitted only after all primary sealed domains pass; a failure freezes the result and triggers analysis under a new protocol, not v0 retuning.
